_comment: Fabric Data Factory pipeline for Module 5. Import into the Fabric
already filled in below. Three values remain, none of which exist until
the artifacts are created in Fabric:
notebookId  - assigned when nb_module5_capacity_denial is imported
objectId    - assigned when this pipeline is created
key_vault_name / ops alert target - your choice of vault and mailbox
Shape: run the notebook -> on success, do nothing further (the notebook
writes the Gold tables and the finding the web application serves); on
failure, send a short operational alert so a silent break is impossible.
name: PL_Module5_CapacityDenialRevenueImpact

properties.description: Module 5 -- classify capacity denials, size revenue exposure, publish the ranked finding for human review in the web application.

typeProperties._comment: Operational alert only -- findings are never delivered this way; the web application is the only surface for them.
